title: Wegovy vs Ozempic
shortAnswer: Both contain semaglutide (same active ingredient) and are made by Novo Nordisk. Ozempic (0.5-2mg) is FDA-approved for type 2 diabetes. Wegovy (2.4mg, higher dose) is FDA-approved for chronic weight management. Wegovy produces greater average weight loss (~15-17%).
verdict: Ozempic is the diabetes treatment; Wegovy is the weight loss version. If you have diabetes, Ozempic is prescribed; if the goal is weight loss without diabetes, Wegovy is the indicated drug.
